prompt: Create a multi-step registration form for our Angular app. It should have 3 steps: Personal Info (name, email, phone), Address (street, city, postal code, country), and Review & Submit. Use progressive disclosure, smart defaults (detect country from browser locale), and make the form use the full viewport width on all screen sizes. We're using Tailwind in this project.

assertions.text: Has both smart (container) and dumb (presentational) components with clear separation
All components use separate .html and .scss files, never inline
Steps are revealed progressively (not all visible at once), using stepper/wizard pattern
Country field pre-selects based on browser locale (Intl API or navigator.language)
Fields are grouped logically (3-5 per step), not all in one long form
Form layout uses full available width (grid/flex), not a narrow centered column
Uses Tailwind classes with rhythm-aligned spacing or custom spacing scale
Stepper has ARIA attributes (aria-current, role, step labels for screen readers)
Step navigation is keyboard-accessible (focus management between steps)
Has Storybook stories for individual steps and/or the full flow
Review step shows a summary of all entered data before submission
Includes a standalone HTML mockup with working step navigation
